Augustin S. Macdonald, comp.  A Collection of Verse by California Poets.  1914.

By Harold Symmes

Titans of Earth

Sierran Summits
P
EAK
 upon peak uptowering, these mountain giants rise,
Piercing with their summits the far cerulean skies,—
Mighty shouldered Titans relentlessly uphurled
In the grinding pack and pressure that, battling, builds the world.
With slow corroding fingers Time wears their bastions low,
Wreathing the gaping gashes with garlands of her snow.
